text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Fufu... It's finally time, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Even if I eat their dust and fall to my knees,
I will make a glorious comeback—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
After all, it is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity
to show everyone what true "strength" is.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: I shall be on my way, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: This time for sure, an overwhelming victory—
